findings.problem: Whole-window tintSoft bounding union is not bound to Retry, its label, target or banner. An unrelated matching rectangle or disconnected patches can satisfy every new area/height/aspect assertion while Retry itself is wrong. There is no card-margin or target-inset check.
findings.evidence: Actual extracted raw-pixel scan + same three assertions accepts unrelated64x28 patch when modeledRetry56x56 is elsewhere; disconnected16x10 patches also pass. Inert buffers demonstrate oracle susceptibility, not current actual UIKit render.

findings.problem: Changing native bordered styling to explicit tintSoft changes the pixels used to find the alleged capsule. Zero matching tintSoft area in the old style can fail the first assertion even when geometry is identical. Therefore a color-only fail-before does not establish a geometry regression.
findings.evidence: Actual scan applied to identical64x28 bounds passes target fill and fails solely with another opaque fill. No native before-change image or68x56 independent measurement was audited.

recommended_oracle: Bind the actual Retry instance, label, painted capsule and banner/outer-target geometry in one UIWindow coordinate space. Existing in-process HostedTestSeam explicitly says native AX traversal unreliable: do not invent a batch/native AX accessor. Supported SwiftUI layout probes may provide crop geometry but must be non-layout-affecting and are not native hit proof.

Crop that actual rendered control region and positively identify its label/connected painted surface relative to the measured label and card. Reject unrelated/disconnected matching pixels. Assert actual capsule containment, target>=44, relative text padding and card/target margins; use text-relative rules for accessibility sizes rather than applying default36pt ceiling universally.

Use geometry discrimination that identifies both native-bordered baseline and tintSoft candidate despite color differences: control-local edge/background contrast or otherwise calibrated segmentation. Establish the old control exists and fails the geometric condition, not only a new-color search. Retain original screenshot attachment; verify coordinate/bitmap conversion before interpreting positions.

Keep native exact-head Retry hit/disabled routing/accessibility label and light/dark/theme default/accessibility rendered geometry plus enabled/pressed/disabled text contrast as separate future proof obligations under existing grants. No run is authorized by this review.
